en-US.title: Syel Form-Qi Face & Palm
en-US.subtitle: BaZi Cross-Ref · Study
en-US.keywords: form-qi,face form,palm form,bazi,four pillars,cultural study,left palm,right palm,face photo
en-US.promotionalText: Left/right palm + face photos → structured form-qi observation with birth BaZi cross-reference. Cultural study — not a clinic readout or a life verdict.
en-US.description:
Syel is a form-qi reading study tool — structured observation of face form (面相) and palm form (掌相), cross-referenced with your birth BaZi (Four Pillars). Not a clinic tool. Not generic matching. Not a life verdict.

WHAT IT IS

• A three-photo workflow: left palm, right palm, and face — each captured on your device for structured form observation.
• A five-chapter cultural brief: overview, face, palms, form × BaZi contrast, and near-term windows worth noting.
• A classical vocabulary layer: dotted terms open glosses; locus maps tie observations to traditional face/palm zones.
• An optional life-axis timeline and what-if sandbox (Pro) for exploring patterns — study framing, not prediction.

WHAT IT IS NOT

• Not a clinic, not a health tool, not Face ID / Touch ID
• Not Western horoscope or generic matching apps
• Not a pass/fail score or guaranteed outcome

WHAT YOU GET

• Structured form-qi reading from your photos + birth details
• BaZi (Four Pillars) cross-reference alongside visible form cues
• Symbol glossary, term sheet, and shareable chapter cards
• Four languages: English, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文

EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT

Syel presents traditional face and palm form concepts as descriptive cultural reference — patterns and tendencies to observe, not medical claims or predicted outcomes.

PRICING

A sealed five-chapter form-qi brief is available as a one-time purchase (store price varies by region). Optional Syel Pro adds archive, periodic re-capture, life-axis timeline, what-if branches, and in-report chat (subscription price varies).

PRIVACY

Drafts stay viewable on your device. Photos are briefly uploaded for feature extraction, then deleted — not kept permanently. After upload you may leave while the cloud continues extract and reading. Birth details sync to your account for readings across devices. See the Privacy Policy for retention and deletion.

ABOUT

Syel is published by UseONE, LLC. Privacy: syel.hexastral.com/en/privacy/syel. Terms: syel.hexastral.com/en/terms.
